notes_for_editor: Only the tnlandforms list has any detail on this tower: county, elevation, removed status, and no state tower code (the other Bledsoe towers on the list have codes, so its absence is noted). No Forest Lookouts, NHLR or firetower.org page was found, and no NGS datasheet is linked. The agency is left out because no source ties Jane Ridge to the Division of Forestry. The Bledsoe State Forest page is cited only for its general fire-tower access rule; no source places Jane Ridge inside that forest. The NRHP Division of Forestry study was read but is not cited, since it does not name this tower and the tower's agency is unknown. Built, staffing, fire and site-today facts are absent, so the story omits them. Two web searches and one state-forest page read were spent here. Next step if more work is wanted: check whether the tnlandforms Bledsoe entries link to a county or Division record for Jane Ridge.
